_comment: This list is deliberately short. The page it replaced carried 78 links
assembled around 2006; an audit on 2026-09-25 found roughly a third dead
and a further dozen silently redirecting to a different company than the
one named in the link text — AIM to Invesco, American Funds to Capital
Group, Heritage to Eagle Asset, SunAmerica to Corebridge. A link labelled
with one firm's name that lands on another firm's sales page is a
communication with the public that the firm cannot stand behind.
So the rule for this file: only regulators, government sites, and tools
the firm is prepared to be associated with. No fund-company home pages —
a representative sends the prospectus that applies. Every entry carries
the date it was last verified. Re-check them annually and update 'checked'.

links.note: Our registration, our representatives, and our disciplinary history.
